title: Engineering Intern - Global Construction Engineering
description:
Job Details:
Job Description:
Global Construction Engineering (GCE) supports the design and engineering of Intel's major manufacturing and cleanroom projects around the world. Join a collaborative team of architects and engineers working with factory, operations and supply chain partners to deliver complex facilities projects. As an intern, you will support experienced engineers, contribute to practical project activities and build your understanding of engineering design and construction.
This multidisciplinary internship welcomes applicants from a range of engineering and built-environment disciplines. Depending on your background and project needs, you may support mechanical, electrical, civil and structural, chemical and process, automation and controls, or building information modelling (BIM) activities. You are not expected to have knowledge of every discipline.
This position will be based in Malaysia.
Responsibilities will include but are not limited to:
Support preliminary studies and data collection for facilities improvement projects under the guidance of experienced engineers.
Participate in supervised site walks and help document existing conditions and project requirements.
Assist engineers with reviewing drawings, specifications and technical documents, and tracking questions for follow-up.
Support coordination across design, construction, scheduling and estimating teams by preparing meeting notes and maintaining action trackers.
Work with facilities operations partners and project teams to gather information and support assigned engineering tasks.
Assist with basic calculations, data analysis, design documentation or model updates relevant to your discipline, with appropriate guidance and review.
Help organize project cost and schedule information and prepare progress summaries for review.
Learn and follow applicable safety requirements, engineering standards and document control processes; contribute ideas for improvement.
Collaborate across disciplines and share project findings and lessons learned with the team.
The successful candidate should exhibit the following behavioral traits:
Curiosity, willingness to learn and confidence to ask questions and seek guidance.
Clear written and verbal communication and a collaborative approach to working with people from different disciplines.
Attention to detail, an organized approach and ownership of assigned tasks with appropriate support.
Value for safety and a safe project environment.
Qualifications:
We welcome students from a broad range of disciplines who are interested in engineering and construction. Previous industry experience is not required. Preferred qualifications are helpful but are not requirements for applying.
Minimum Qualifications:
Currently pursuing a diploma or bachelor's degree in Mechanical, Electrical or Electronic, Civil or Structural, Chemical, Mechatronics, Industrial, Environmental or other engineering disciplines; Architecture, Building Services, Construction Management, or a related technical or built-environment field. Applicants should have an interest in facilities design, construction or project delivery and a willingness to apply their academic learning in a multidisciplinary team.
Preferred Qualifications:
Coursework or academic projects related to engineering design, building systems, construction, manufacturing or sustainability.
Basic ability to interpret technical drawings or analyse engineering information through coursework or projects.
Exposure to one or more design or modelling tools, such as AutoCAD, Revit, Navisworks or similar software; proficiency in all tools is not expected.
Experience using spreadsheets and presentation tools for academic assignments or team projects.
Interest in digital engineering, automation, data analysis, or continuous improvement.
Participation in team projects, student activities or previous placements that demonstrate collaboration and problem-solving.
Job Type:
Student / Intern
Shift:
Shift 1 (Malaysia)
Primary Location:
Malaysia, Penang
Additional Locations:
Posting Statement:
All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, religious creed, sex, national origin, ancestry, age, physical or mental disability, medical condition, genetic information, military and veteran status, marital status, pregnancy, gender, gender expression, gender identity, sexual orientation, or any other characteristic protected by local law, regulation, or ordinance.
Position of Trust
N/A
Work Model for this Role
This role will be eligible for our hybrid work model which allows employees to split their time between working on-site at their assigned Intel site and off-site. * Job posting details (such as work model, location or time type) are subject to change.
*
